issues.detail: The Vietnamese translation omits the word 'ου' (ou), which functions as a negative particle. While the Vietnamese 'không' correctly negates 'làm một việc', it fails to capture the specific scope of 'ου την αυτην εχει πραξιν'. The Greek implies 'not [having] the same [one] function/work', whereas the Vietnamese 'không cùng làm một việc' (do not do the same work) is a slight shift in the nature of the negation regarding the possession of a single function.
